ASSERTION_1_factorial_equals_stock_when_.arms: B (train_factorial init=order=401, no cuDNN flags) vs A (src/train.py seed=401)
ASSERTION_1_factorial_equals_stock_when_.meaning: If IDENTICAL, splitting one seed into (init, order) reproduces the Phase-1 RNG stream EXACTLY. This is what licenses treating INIT and ORDER as separable factors of the same trainer.

ASSERTION_2_p8a_trainer_is_reproducible.arms: C' vs C (train_factorial, cuDNN deterministic, run twice)
ASSERTION_2_p8a_trainer_is_reproducible.meaning: If IDENTICAL, any difference between two P8a cells is caused by the seeds, not by nondeterminism.

INFORMATIONAL_cudnn_flag_effect.meaning: Whether enabling cuDNN determinism changes the trained weights. Either way P8a is unbiased: ALL 48 P8a runs use the same flags.

INFORMATIONAL_phase1_reproducible_across.arms: A (fresh src/train.py seed=401) vs the ARCHIVED runs/stage_G/G000_s401
INFORMATIONAL_phase1_reproducible_across.meaning: Whether a Phase-1 training run reproduces bit-for-bit today. NOT an assertion -- P8a compares runs made here under identical conditions.
